structure Dyadic : Type where
  coeff : Int
  exp : Int

inductive IEEEFloat32Datum : Type where
  | finite : Bool → Nat → Int → IEEEFloat32Datum
  | posInf : IEEEFloat32Datum
  | negInf : IEEEFloat32Datum
  | qNaN : Nat → IEEEFloat32Datum

structure IEEEFloat32 : Type where
  bits : Nat

abbrev Scalar := IEEEFloat32

def pow2 : Nat → Nat
  | Nat.zero => Nat.succ Nat.zero
  | Nat.succ n => Nat.mul (Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero)) (pow2 n)

def mask32 (b : Nat) : Nat :=
  Nat.mod b 

def mkIEEEFloat32 (b : Nat) : IEEEFloat32 :=
  IEEEFloat32.mk (mask32 b)

def signField (b : Nat) : Nat :=
  Nat.mod (Nat.div b ) 2

def exponentField (b : Nat) : Nat :=
  Nat.mod (Nat.div b 8388608) 256

def fractionField (b : Nat) : Nat :=
  Nat.mod b 8388608

def signedCoeff (sign : Nat) (m : Nat) : Int :=
  match Nat.decEq sign 0 with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => Int.ofNat m
  | Decidable.isFalse _ => Int.ofNat m

def decodeBits (b : Nat) : IEEEFloat32Datum :=
  let bb := mask32 b
  let s := signField bb
  let e := exponentField bb
  let f := fractionField bb
  match Nat.decEq e 255 with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
      match Nat.decEq f 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
          match Nat.decEq s 0 with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => IEEEFloat32Datum.posInf
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => IEEEFloat32Datum.negInf
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => IEEEFloat32Datum.qNaN f
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decEq e 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
          match Nat.decEq f 0 with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => IEEEFloat32Datum.finite (match Nat.decEq s 0 with | Decidable.isTrue _ => false | Decidable.isFalse _ => true) 0 (149)
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => IEEEFloat32Datum.finite (match Nat.decEq s 0 with | Decidable.isTrue _ => false | Decidable.isFalse _ => true) f (149)
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          IEEEFloat32Datum.finite
            (match Nat.decEq s 0 with | Decidable.isTrue _ => false | Decidable.isFalse _ => true)
            (Nat.add 8388608 f)
            (Int.sub (Int.ofNat e) 150)

def decode (x : IEEEFloat32) : IEEEFloat32Datum :=
  decodeBits x.bits

def finiteDyadicOfBits (b : Nat) : Option Dyadic :=
  let bb := mask32 b
  let s := signField bb
  let e := exponentField bb
  let f := fractionField bb
  match Nat.decEq e 255 with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => Option.none
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decEq e 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
          Option.some (Dyadic.mk (signedCoeff s f) (149))
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          Option.some (Dyadic.mk (signedCoeff s (Nat.add 8388608 f)) (Int.sub (Int.ofNat e) 150))

def intAbsNat (z : Int) : Nat :=
  match inferInstance : Decidable (0 ≤ z) with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => Int.toNat z
  | Decidable.isFalse _ => Int.toNat (z)

def intShift (z : Int) (n : Nat) : Int :=
  Int.mul z (Int.ofNat (pow2 n))

def dyadicAlignLeftCoeff (x y : Dyadic) : Int :=
  match inferInstance : Decidable (x.exp ≤ y.exp) with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => x.coeff
  | Decidable.isFalse _ => intShift x.coeff (Int.toNat (Int.sub x.exp y.exp))

def dyadicAlignRightCoeff (x y : Dyadic) : Int :=
  match inferInstance : Decidable (x.exp ≤ y.exp) with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => intShift y.coeff (Int.toNat (Int.sub y.exp x.exp))
  | Decidable.isFalse _ => y.coeff

def dyadicCommonExp (x y : Dyadic) : Int :=
  match inferInstance : Decidable (x.exp ≤ y.exp) with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => x.exp
  | Decidable.isFalse _ => y.exp

def dyadicAdd (x y : Dyadic) : Dyadic :=
  Dyadic.mk
    (Int.add (dyadicAlignLeftCoeff x y) (dyadicAlignRightCoeff x y))
    (dyadicCommonExp x y)

def dyadicNeg (x : Dyadic) : Dyadic :=
  Dyadic.mk (x.coeff) x.exp

def dyadicSub (x y : Dyadic) : Dyadic :=
  dyadicAdd x (dyadicNeg y)

def dyadicMul (x y : Dyadic) : Dyadic :=
  Dyadic.mk (Int.mul x.coeff y.coeff) (Int.add x.exp y.exp)

def dyadicAbsLe (x y : Dyadic) : Bool :=
  let ax := intAbsNat x.coeff
  let ay := intAbsNat y.coeff
  match inferInstance : Decidable (x.exp ≤ y.exp) with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
      match inferInstance : Decidable (ax ≤ Nat.mul ay (pow2 (Int.toNat (Int.sub y.exp x.exp)))) with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => true
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => false
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match inferInstance : Decidable (Nat.mul ax (pow2 (Int.toNat (Int.sub x.exp y.exp))) ≤ ay) with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => true
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => false

def dyadicAbsLt (x y : Dyadic) : Bool :=
  let ax := intAbsNat x.coeff
  let ay := intAbsNat y.coeff
  match inferInstance : Decidable (x.exp ≤ y.exp) with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
      match inferInstance : Decidable (ax < Nat.mul ay (pow2 (Int.toNat (Int.sub y.exp x.exp)))) with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => true
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => false
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match inferInstance : Decidable (Nat.mul ax (pow2 (Int.toNat (Int.sub x.exp y.exp))) < ay) with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => true
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => false

def dyadicAbsEq (x y : Dyadic) : Bool :=
  match dyadicAbsLe x y with
  | true =>
      match dyadicAbsLe y x with
      | true => true
      | false => false
  | false => false

def candidateDistance (target : Dyadic) (bits : Nat) : Option Dyadic :=
  match finiteDyadicOfBits bits with
  | Option.none => Option.none
  | Option.some d => Option.some (dyadicSub d target)

def candidateIsEven (bits : Nat) : Bool :=
  match Nat.decEq (Nat.mod bits 2) 0 with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => true
  | Decidable.isFalse _ => false

def candidateBetter (target : Dyadic) (candidate best : Nat) : Bool :=
  match candidateDistance target candidate, candidateDistance target best with
  | Option.some dc, Option.some db =>
      match dyadicAbsLt dc db with
      | true => true
      | false =>
          match dyadicAbsEq dc db with
          | true => candidateIsEven candidate
          | false => false
  | Option.some _, Option.none => true
  | Option.none, Option.some _ => false
  | Option.none, Option.none => false

def nearestFiniteSearch (target : Dyadic) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | Nat.zero, best => best
  | Nat.succ k, best =>
      let previous := nearestFiniteSearch target k best
      match candidateBetter target k previous with
      | true => k
      | false => previous

def roundFiniteDyadicRTNE (target : Dyadic) : IEEEFloat32 :=
  mkIEEEFloat32 (nearestFiniteSearch target [4294967296 0](tel:4294967296 0))

inductive ExactBinary32 : Type where
  | nan : ExactBinary32
  | posInf : ExactBinary32
  | negInf : ExactBinary32
  | finite : Dyadic → ExactBinary32

def exactOfFloat (x : IEEEFloat32) : ExactBinary32 :=
  match decode x with
  | IEEEFloat32Datum.qNaN _ => ExactBinary32.nan
  | IEEEFloat32Datum.posInf => ExactBinary32.posInf
  | IEEEFloat32Datum.negInf => ExactBinary32.negInf
  | IEEEFloat32Datum.finite neg sig exp =>
      match neg with
      | true => ExactBinary32.finite (Dyadic.mk (Int.ofNat sig) exp)
      | false => ExactBinary32.finite (Dyadic.mk (Int.ofNat sig) exp)

def quietNaN : IEEEFloat32 :=
  mkIEEEFloat32 

def positiveInfinity : IEEEFloat32 :=
  mkIEEEFloat32 

def negativeInfinity : IEEEFloat32 :=
  mkIEEEFloat32 

def roundExactBinary32RTNE (x : ExactBinary32) : IEEEFloat32 :=
  match x with
  | ExactBinary32.nan => quietNaN
  | ExactBinary32.posInf => positiveInfinity
  | ExactBinary32.negInf => negativeInfinity
  | ExactBinary32.finite d => roundFiniteDyadicRTNE d

def exactAdd (a b : ExactBinary32) : ExactBinary32 :=
  match a, b with
  | ExactBinary32.nan, _ => ExactBinary32.nan
  | _, ExactBinary32.nan => ExactBinary32.nan
  | ExactBinary32.posInf, ExactBinary32.negInf => ExactBinary32.nan
  | ExactBinary32.negInf, ExactBinary32.posInf => ExactBinary32.nan
  | ExactBinary32.posInf, _ => ExactBinary32.posInf
  | _, ExactBinary32.posInf => ExactBinary32.posInf
  | ExactBinary32.negInf, _ => ExactBinary32.negInf
  | _, ExactBinary32.negInf => ExactBinary32.negInf
  | ExactBinary32.finite x, ExactBinary32.finite y => ExactBinary32.finite (dyadicAdd x y)

def exactMul (a b : ExactBinary32) : ExactBinary32 :=
  match a, b with
  | ExactBinary32.nan, _ => ExactBinary32.nan
  | _, ExactBinary32.nan => ExactBinary32.nan
  | ExactBinary32.posInf, ExactBinary32.posInf => ExactBinary32.posInf
  | ExactBinary32.negInf, ExactBinary32.negInf => ExactBinary32.posInf
  | ExactBinary32.posInf, ExactBinary32.negInf => ExactBinary32.negInf
  | ExactBinary32.negInf, ExactBinary32.posInf => ExactBinary32.negInf
  | ExactBinary32.posInf, ExactBinary32.finite d =>
      match Int.decEq d.coeff 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.nan
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          match inferInstance : Decidable (d.coeff < 0) with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.negInf
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => ExactBinary32.posInf
  | ExactBinary32.negInf, ExactBinary32.finite d =>
      match Int.decEq d.coeff 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.nan
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          match inferInstance : Decidable (d.coeff < 0) with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.posInf
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => ExactBinary32.negInf
  | ExactBinary32.finite d, ExactBinary32.posInf =>
      match Int.decEq d.coeff 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.nan
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          match inferInstance : Decidable (d.coeff < 0) with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.negInf
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => ExactBinary32.posInf
  | ExactBinary32.finite d, ExactBinary32.negInf =>
      match Int.decEq d.coeff 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.nan
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          match inferInstance : Decidable (d.coeff < 0) with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.posInf
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => ExactBinary32.negInf
  | ExactBinary32.finite x, ExactBinary32.finite y => ExactBinary32.finite (dyadicMul x y)

def ieee754Binary32AddRoundToNearestTiesToEven (a b : IEEEFloat32) : IEEEFloat32 :=
  roundExactBinary32RTNE (exactAdd (exactOfFloat a) (exactOfFloat b))

def ieee754Binary32MulRoundToNearestTiesToEven (a b : IEEEFloat32) : IEEEFloat32 :=
  roundExactBinary32RTNE (exactMul (exactOfFloat a) (exactOfFloat b))

def semanticEq (a b : IEEEFloat32) : Prop :=
  decode a = decode b

def fadd (a b : Scalar) : Scalar :=
  ieee754Binary32AddRoundToNearestTiesToEven a b

def fmul (a b : Scalar) : Scalar :=
  ieee754Binary32MulRoundToNearestTiesToEven a b

def zigF32Add (a b : Scalar) : Scalar :=
  ieee754Binary32AddRoundToNearestTiesToEven a b

def zigF32Mul (a b : Scalar) : Scalar :=
  ieee754Binary32MulRoundToNearestTiesToEven a b

def fractalScale : Scalar :=
  mkIEEEFloat32 

def halfCoeff : Scalar :=
  mkIEEEFloat32 

def natTwo : Nat :=
  Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero)

def maxBufSize : Nat :=
  16384

def regionX1 : Nat :=
  Nat.zero

def regionX2 : Nat :=
  Nat.succ Nat.zero

def regionStack : Nat :=
  Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero)

structure Slice : Type where
  region : Nat
  ptr : Nat
  len : Nat

structure Tensor : Type where
  data : Slice

structure BackwardSlice : Type where
  data : Slice

structure OFTB : Type where
  fractal_scale : Scalar
  dim : Nat

structure Heap : Type where
  mem : Nat → Nat → Scalar
  stack_top : Nat

structure ZigState : Type where
  mem : Nat → Nat → Scalar
  stack_base : Nat

def init (d : Nat) : OFTB :=
  OFTB.mk fractalScale d

def readHeap (h : Heap) (region addr : Nat) : Scalar :=
  h.mem region addr

def writeHeap (h : Heap) (region addr : Nat) (v : Scalar) : Heap :=
  Heap.mk
    (fun r a =>
      match Nat.decEq r region with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
          match Nat.decEq a addr with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => v
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => h.mem r a
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => h.mem r a)
    h.stack_top

def restoreStack (h : Heap) (top : Nat) : Heap :=
  Heap.mk h.mem top

def readSlice (h : Heap) (s : Slice) (idx : Nat) : Scalar :=
  readHeap h s.region idx

def writeSlice (h : Heap) (s : Slice) (idx : Nat) (v : Scalar) : Heap :=
  writeHeap h s.region idx v

def zRead (σ : ZigState) (region addr : Nat) : Scalar :=
  σ.mem region addr

def zWrite (σ : ZigState) (region addr : Nat) (v : Scalar) : ZigState :=
  ZigState.mk
    (fun r a =>
      match Nat.decEq r region with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
          match Nat.decEq a addr with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => v
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => σ.mem r a
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => σ.mem r a)
    σ.stack_base

def zReadSlice (σ : ZigState) (s : Slice) (idx : Nat) : Scalar :=
  zRead σ s.region idx

def zWriteSlice (σ : ZigState) (s : Slice) (idx : Nat) (v : Scalar) : ZigState :=
  zWrite σ s.region idx v

def repr (σ : ZigState) : Heap :=
  Heap.mk σ.mem σ.stack_base

def stateOfHeap (h : Heap) : ZigState :=
  ZigState.mk h.mem h.stack_top

def splitTensor (t : Tensor) (half : Nat) : Prod Slice Slice :=
  Prod.mk
    (Slice.mk regionX1 t.data.ptr half)
    (Slice.mk regionX2 (Nat.add t.data.ptr half) half)

def splitBackwardSlice (g : BackwardSlice) (half : Nat) : Prod Slice Slice :=
  Prod.mk
    (Slice.mk regionX1 g.data.ptr half)
    (Slice.mk regionX2 (Nat.add g.data.ptr half) half)

def allocStack (h : Heap) (n : Nat) : Prod Slice Heap :=
  Prod.mk
    (Slice.mk regionStack h.stack_top n)
    (Heap.mk h.mem (Nat.add h.stack_top n))

def isDisjoint (s1 s2 : Slice) : Prop :=
  s1.region ≠ s2.region ∨
    ((Nat.add s1.ptr s1.len ≤ s2.ptr) ∨ (Nat.add s2.ptr s2.len ≤ s1.ptr))

def guardedCell (old new : Scalar) (idx n : Nat) : Scalar :=
  match Nat.decLt idx n with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => new
  | Decidable.isFalse _ => old

def mixBufLoop (h : Heap) (src buf : Slice) (n : Nat) : Heap :=
  Heap.mk
    (fun r a =>
      match Nat.decEq r buf.region with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => guardedCell (readHeap h r a) (readSlice h src a) a n
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => readHeap h r a)
    h.stack_top

def addScaledLoop (h : Heap) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar) (n : Nat) : Heap :=
  Heap.mk
    (fun r a =>
      match Nat.decEq r dst.region with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
          guardedCell
            (readHeap h r a)
            (fadd (readSlice h dst a) (fmul (readSlice h src a) scale))
            a
            n
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => readHeap h r a)
    h.stack_top

def addScaledHalfLoop (h : Heap) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar) (n : Nat) : Heap :=
  Heap.mk
    (fun r a =>
      match Nat.decEq r dst.region with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
          guardedCell
            (readHeap h r a)
            (fadd (readSlice h dst a) (fmul (fmul (readSlice h src a) scale) halfCoeff))
            a
            n
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => readHeap h r a)
    h.stack_top

def forwardRunHeap (h : Heap) (t : Tensor) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar) : Heap :=
  let x1 := Prod.fst (splitTensor t dim)
  let x2 := Prod.snd (splitTensor t dim)
  let stackAlloc := allocStack h dim
  let mix_buf := Prod.fst stackAlloc
  let h0 := Prod.snd stackAlloc
  let h1 := mixBufLoop h0 x1 mix_buf dim
  let h2 := addScaledLoop h1 x1 x2 scale dim
  let h3 := addScaledHalfLoop h2 x2 mix_buf scale dim
  restoreStack h3 h.stack_top

def backwardRunHeap (h : Heap) (g : BackwardSlice) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar) : Heap :=
  let g1 := Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g dim)
  let g2 := Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g dim)
  let stackAlloc := allocStack h dim
  let buf := Prod.fst stackAlloc
  let h0 := Prod.snd stackAlloc
  let h1 := mixBufLoop h0 g2 buf dim
  let h2 := addScaledLoop h1 g2 g1 scale dim
  let h3 := addScaledHalfLoop h2 g1 buf scale dim
  restoreStack h3 h.stack_top

def forwardHeap (h : Heap) (t : Tensor) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar) : Heap :=
  match Nat.decLt t.data.len (Nat.mul dim natTwo) with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => h
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decLt maxBufSize dim with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => h
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => forwardRunHeap h t dim scale

def backwardHeap (h : Heap) (g : BackwardSlice) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar) : Heap :=
  match Nat.decLt g.data.len (Nat.mul dim natTwo) with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => h
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decLt maxBufSize dim with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => h
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => backwardRunHeap h g dim scale

def ZigForwardInPlace (σ : ZigState) (x : Tensor) (self : OFTB) : ZigState :=
  stateOfHeap (forwardHeap (repr σ) x self.dim self.fractal_scale)

def ZigBackwardInPlace (σ : ZigState) (grad : BackwardSlice) (self : OFTB) : ZigState :=
  stateOfHeap (backwardHeap (repr σ) grad self.dim self.fractal_scale)

inductive ExecMixBuf : ZigState → Slice → Slice → Nat → ZigState → Prop where
  | zero : ∀ (σ : ZigState) (src buf : Slice), ExecMixBuf σ src buf 0 σ
  | succ : ∀ (σ σ' : ZigState) (src buf : Slice) (k : Nat),
      ExecMixBuf σ src buf k σ' →
      ExecMixBuf σ src buf (Nat.succ k)
        (zWriteSlice σ' buf k (zReadSlice σ' src k))

inductive ExecAddScaled : ZigState → Slice → Slice → Scalar → Nat → ZigState → Prop where
  | zero : ∀ (σ : ZigState) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar),
      ExecAddScaled σ dst src scale 0 σ
  | succ : ∀ (σ σ' : ZigState) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar) (k : Nat),
      ExecAddScaled σ dst src scale k σ' →
      ExecAddScaled σ dst src scale (Nat.succ k)
        (zWriteSlice σ' dst k
          (fadd (zReadSlice σ' dst k) (fmul (zReadSlice σ' src k) scale)))

inductive ExecAddScaledHalf : ZigState → Slice → Slice → Scalar → Nat → ZigState → Prop where
  | zero : ∀ (σ : ZigState) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar),
      ExecAddScaledHalf σ dst src scale 0 σ
  | succ : ∀ (σ σ' : ZigState) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar) (k : Nat),
      ExecAddScaledHalf σ dst src scale k σ' →
      ExecAddScaledHalf σ dst src scale (Nat.succ k)
        (zWriteSlice σ' dst k
          (fadd (zReadSlice σ' dst k) (fmul (fmul (zReadSlice σ' src k) scale) halfCoeff)))

inductive ExecForward : ZigState → Tensor → OFTB → ZigState → Prop where
  | early_len : ∀ (σ : ZigState) (t : Tensor) (self : OFTB),
      t.data.len < self.dim  natTwo →
      ExecForward σ t self σ
  | early_buf : ∀ (σ : ZigState) (t : Tensor) (self : OFTB),
      ¬ (t.data.len < self.dim  natTwo) →
      maxBufSize < self.dim →
      ExecForward σ t self σ
  | run : ∀ (σ σ1 σ2 σ3 : ZigState) (t : Tensor) (self : OFTB) (mix_buf : Slice),
      ¬ (t.data.len < self.dim  natTwo) →
      ¬ (maxBufSize < self.dim) →
      (Prod.fst (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim)) = mix_buf →
      ExecMixBuf (stateOfHeap (Prod.snd (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim))) (Prod.fst (splitTensor t self.dim)) mix_buf self.dim σ1 →
      ExecAddScaled σ1 (Prod.fst (splitTensor t self.dim)) (Prod.snd (splitTensor t self.dim)) self.fractal_scale self.dim σ2 →
      ExecAddScaledHalf σ2 (Prod.snd (splitTensor t self.dim)) mix_buf self.fractal_scale self.dim σ3 →
      ExecForward σ t self (stateOfHeap (restoreStack (repr σ3) σ.stack_base))

inductive ExecBackward : ZigState → BackwardSlice → OFTB → ZigState → Prop where
  | early_len : ∀ (σ : ZigState) (g : BackwardSlice) (self : OFTB),
      g.data.len < self.dim  natTwo →
      ExecBackward σ g self σ
  | early_buf : ∀ (σ : ZigState) (g : BackwardSlice) (self : OFTB),
      ¬ (g.data.len < self.dim  natTwo) →
      maxBufSize < self.dim →
      ExecBackward σ g self σ
  | run : ∀ (σ σ1 σ2 σ3 : ZigState) (g : BackwardSlice) (self : OFTB) (buf : Slice),
      ¬ (g.data.len < self.dim  natTwo) →
      ¬ (maxBufSize < self.dim) →
      (Prod.fst (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim)) = buf →
      ExecMixBuf (stateOfHeap (Prod.snd (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim))) (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) buf self.dim σ1 →
      ExecAddScaled σ1 (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) self.fractal_scale self.dim σ2 →
      ExecAddScaledHalf σ2 (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) buf self.fractal_scale self.dim σ3 →
      ExecBackward σ g self (stateOfHeap (restoreStack (repr σ3) σ.stack_base))

theorem repr_stateOfHeap (h : Heap) :
  repr (stateOfHeap h) = h :=
  match h with
  | Heap.mk mem stack_top => Eq.refl _

theorem stateOfHeap_repr (σ : ZigState) :
  stateOfHeap (repr σ) = σ :=
  match σ with
  | ZigState.mk mem stack_base => Eq.refl _

theorem fadd_is_zig_f32_add (a b : Scalar) :
  semanticEq (fadd a b) (zigF32Add a b) :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem fmul_is_zig_f32_mul (a b : Scalar) :
  semanticEq (fmul a b) (zigF32Mul a b) :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem fractalScale_is_zig_literal :
  semanticEq fractalScale (mkIEEEFloat32 ) :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem halfCoeff_is_zig_literal :
  semanticEq halfCoeff (mkIEEEFloat32 ) :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem addScaledLoop_at_dst (h : Heap) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar) (n m : Nat)
  (hm : m < n) :
  semanticEq
    (readSlice (addScaledLoop h dst src scale n) dst m)
    (fadd (readSlice h dst m) (fmul (readSlice h src m) scale)) :=
  match Nat.decEq dst.region dst.region with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
      match Nat.decLt m n with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => Eq.refl _
      | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf hm)
  | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf (Eq.refl _))

theorem regionX1_ne_regionX2 : regionX1 ≠ regionX2 :=
  fun h => Nat.noConfusion h

theorem regionX2_ne_regionX1 : regionX2 ≠ regionX1 :=
  fun h => Nat.noConfusion h

theorem execMixBuf_exists (σ : ZigState) (src buf : Slice) (n : Nat) :
  ∃ σ', ExecMixBuf σ src buf n σ' :=

    (Exists.intro σ (ExecMixBuf.zero σ src buf))

      match ih with

            (zWriteSlice σk buf k (zReadSlice σk src k))

theorem execAddScaled_exists (σ : ZigState) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar) (n : Nat) :
  ∃ σ', ExecAddScaled σ dst src scale n σ' :=

    (Exists.intro σ (ExecAddScaled.zero σ dst src scale))

theorem execForward_exists (σ : ZigState) (t : Tensor) (self : OFTB) :
  ∃ σ', ExecForward σ t self σ' :=
  match Nat.decLt t.data.len (self.dim  natTwo) with
  | Decidable.isTrue hlt =>
      Exists.intro σ (ExecForward.early_len σ t self hlt)
  | Decidable.isFalse hnlen =>

      | Decidable.isTrue hbuf =>

      | Decidable.isFalse hnbuf =>

            (stateOfHeap (Prod.snd (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim)))
            (Prod.fst (splitTensor t self.dim))
            (Prod.fst (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim))
            self.dim with

              | Exists.intro σ2 h2 =>
                  match execAddScaledHalf_exists σ2 (Prod.snd (splitTensor t self.dim)) (Prod.fst (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim)) self.fractal_scale self.dim with
                  | Exists.intro σ3 h3 =>
                      Exists.intro
                        (stateOfHeap (restoreStack (repr σ3) σ.stack_base))
                        (ExecForward.run σ σ1 σ2 σ3 t self (Prod.fst (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim)) hnlen hnbuf (Eq.refl _) h1 h2 h3)

theorem execBackward_exists (σ : ZigState) (g : BackwardSlice) (self : OFTB) :
  ∃ σ', ExecBackward σ g self σ' :=
  match Nat.decLt g.data.len (self.dim  natTwo) with
  | Decidable.isTrue hlt =>
      Exists.intro σ (ExecBackward.early_len σ g self hlt)
  | Decidable.isFalse hnlen =>

      | Decidable.isTrue hbuf =>

      | Decidable.isFalse hnbuf =>
          match execMixBuf_exists
            (stateOfHeap (Prod.snd (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim)))
            (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim))
            (Prod.fst (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim))
            self.dim with
          | Exists.intro σ1 h1 =>
              match execAddScaled_exists σ1 (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) self.fractal_scale self.dim with
              | Exists.intro σ2 h2 =>
                  match execAddScaledHalf_exists σ2 (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) (Prod.fst (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim)) self.fractal_scale self.dim with
                  | Exists.intro σ3 h3 =>
                      Exists.intro
                        (stateOfHeap (restoreStack (repr σ3) σ.stack_base))
                        (ExecBackward.run σ σ1 σ2 σ3 g self (Prod.fst (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim)) hnlen hnbuf (Eq.refl _) h1 h2 h3)

theorem forward_x1_spec (h : Heap) (t : Tensor) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar)
  (hnlen : ¬ (t.data.len < dim  natTwo))
  (hnbuf : ¬ (maxBufSize < dim))
  (m : Nat) (hm : m < dim) :
  semanticEq
    (readSlice (forwardHeap h t dim scale) (Prod.fst (splitTensor t dim)) m)
    (zigF32Add (readSlice h (Prod.fst (splitTensor t dim)) m)
      (zigF32Mul (readSlice h (Prod.snd (splitTensor t dim)) m) scale)) :=
  match Nat.decLt t.data.len (dim  natTwo) with
  | Decidable.isTrue hlt => False.elim (hnlen hlt)
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decLt maxBufSize dim with
      | Decidable.isTrue hbuf => False.elim (hnbuf hbuf)
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          match Nat.decEq regionX1 regionX1 with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
              match Nat.decLt m dim with
              | Decidable.isTrue _ => Eq.refl _
              | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf hm)
          | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf (Eq.refl _))

theorem forward_x2_spec (h : Heap) (t : Tensor) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar)
  (hnlen : ¬ (t.data.len < dim  natTwo))
  (hnbuf : ¬ (maxBufSize < dim))
  (m : Nat) (hm : m < dim) :
  semanticEq
    (readSlice (forwardHeap h t dim scale) (Prod.snd (splitTensor t dim)) m)
    (zigF32Add (readSlice h (Prod.snd (splitTensor t dim)) m)
      (zigF32Mul (zigF32Mul (readSlice h (Prod.fst (splitTensor t dim)) m) scale) halfCoeff)) :=
  match Nat.decLt t.data.len (dim  natTwo) with
  | Decidable.isTrue hlt => False.elim (hnlen hlt)
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decLt maxBufSize dim with
      | Decidable.isTrue hbuf => False.elim (hnbuf hbuf)
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          match Nat.decEq regionX2 regionX1 with
          | Decidable.isTrue hx => False.elim (regionX2_ne_regionX1 hx)
          | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
              match Nat.decEq regionX2 regionX2 with
              | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
                  match Nat.decEq regionStack regionX1 with
                  | Decidable.isTrue hs => False.elim (regionStack_ne_regionX1 hs)
                  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
                      match Nat.decEq regionStack regionStack with
                      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
                          match Nat.decLt m dim with
                          | Decidable.isTrue _ => Eq.refl _
                          | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf hm)
                      | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf (Eq.refl _))
              | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf (Eq.refl _))

theorem backward_g2_spec (h : Heap) (g : BackwardSlice) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar)
  (hnlen : ¬ (g.data.len < dim  natTwo))
  (hnbuf : ¬ (maxBufSize < dim))
  (m : Nat) (hm : m < dim) :
  semanticEq
    (readSlice (backwardHeap h g dim scale) (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g dim)) m)
    (zigF32Add (readSlice h (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g dim)) m)
      (zigF32Mul (readSlice h (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g dim)) m) scale)) :=
  match Nat.decLt g.data.len (dim  natTwo) with
  | Decidable.isTrue hlt => False.elim (hnlen hlt)
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decLt maxBufSize dim with
      | Decidable.isTrue hbuf => False.elim (hnbuf hbuf)
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          match Nat.decEq regionX2 regionX2 with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
              match Nat.decLt m dim with
              | Decidable.isTrue _ => Eq.refl _
              | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf hm)
          | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf (Eq.refl _))

theorem backward_g1_spec (h : Heap) (g : BackwardSlice) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar)
  (hnlen : ¬ (g.data.len < dim  natTwo))
  (hnbuf : ¬ (maxBufSize < dim))
  (m : Nat) (hm : m < dim) :
  semanticEq
    (readSlice (backwardHeap h g dim scale) (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g dim)) m)
    (zigF32Add (readSlice h (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g dim)) m)
      (zigF32Mul (zigF32Mul (readSlice h (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g dim)) m) scale) halfCoeff)) :=
  match Nat.decLt g.data.len (dim  natTwo) with
  | Decidable.isTrue hlt => False.elim (hnlen hlt)
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decLt maxBufSize dim with
      | Decidable.isTrue hbuf => False.elim (hnbuf hbuf)
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          match Nat.decEq regionX1 regionX2 with
          | Decidable.isTrue hx => False.elim (regionX1_ne_regionX2 hx)
          | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
              match Nat.decEq regionX1 regionX1 with
              | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
                  match Nat.decEq regionStack regionX2 with
                  | Decidable.isTrue hs => False.elim (regionStack_ne_regionX2 hs)
                  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
                      match Nat.decEq regionStack regionStack with
                      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
                          match Nat.decLt m dim with
                          | Decidable.isTrue _ => Eq.refl _
                          | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf hm)
                      | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf (Eq.refl _))
              | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf (Eq.refl _))

theorem forward_full_correct (h : Heap) (t : Tensor) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar)
  (hnlen : ¬ (t.data.len < dim  natTwo))
  (hnbuf : ¬ (maxBufSize < dim)) :
  (∀ m : Nat, m < dim →
    semanticEq
      (readSlice (forwardHeap h t dim scale) (Prod.fst (splitTensor t dim)) m)
      (zigF32Add (readSlice h (Prod.fst (splitTensor t dim)) m)
        (zigF32Mul (readSlice h (Prod.snd (splitTensor t dim)) m) scale))) ∧
  (∀ m : Nat, m < dim →
    semanticEq
      (readSlice (forwardHeap h t dim scale) (Prod.snd (splitTensor t dim)) m)
      (zigF32Add (readSlice h (Prod.snd (splitTensor t dim)) m)
        (zigF32Mul (zigF32Mul (readSlice h (Prod.fst (splitTensor t dim)) m) scale) halfCoeff))) :=
  And.intro
    (fun m hm => forward_x1_spec h t dim scale hnlen hnbuf m hm)
    (fun m hm => forward_x2_spec h t dim scale hnlen hnbuf m hm)

theorem backward_full_correct (h : Heap) (g : BackwardSlice) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar)
  (hnlen : ¬ (g.data.len < dim  natTwo))
  (hnbuf : ¬ (maxBufSize < dim)) :
  (∀ m : Nat, m < dim →
    semanticEq
      (readSlice (backwardHeap h g dim scale) (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g dim)) m)
      (zigF32Add (readSlice h (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g dim)) m)
        (zigF32Mul (readSlice h (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g dim)) m) scale))) ∧
  (∀ m : Nat, m < dim →
    semanticEq
      (readSlice (backwardHeap h g dim scale) (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g dim)) m)
      (zigF32Add (readSlice h (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g dim)) m)
        (zigF32Mul (zigF32Mul (readSlice h (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g dim)) m) scale) halfCoeff))) :=
  And.intro
    (fun m hm => backward_g2_spec h g dim scale hnlen hnbuf m hm)
    (fun m hm => backward_g1_spec h g dim scale hnlen hnbuf m hm)

theorem forwardInPlace_full_correct (σ : ZigState) (t : Tensor) (self : OFTB)
  (hnlen : ¬ (t.data.len < self.dim  natTwo))
  (hnbuf : ¬ (maxBufSize < self.dim)) :
  (∀ m : Nat, m < self.dim →
    semanticEq
      (zReadSlice (ZigForwardInPlace σ t self) (Prod.fst (splitTensor t self.dim)) m)
      (zigF32Add (zReadSlice σ (Prod.fst (splitTensor t self.dim)) m)
        (zigF32Mul (zReadSlice σ (Prod.snd (splitTensor t self.dim)) m) self.fractal_scale))) ∧
  (∀ m : Nat, m < self.dim →
    semanticEq
      (zReadSlice (ZigForwardInPlace σ t self) (Prod.snd (splitTensor t self.dim)) m)
      (zigF32Add (zReadSlice σ (Prod.snd (splitTensor t self.dim)) m)
        (zigF32Mul (zigF32Mul (zReadSlice σ (Prod.fst (splitTensor t self.dim)) m) self.fractal_scale) halfCoeff))) :=
  forward_full_correct (repr σ) t self.dim self.fractal_scale hnlen hnbuf

theorem backwardInPlace_full_correct (σ : ZigState) (g : BackwardSlice) (self : OFTB)
  (hnlen : ¬ (g.data.len < self.dim  natTwo))
  (hnbuf : ¬ (maxBufSize < self.dim)) :
  (∀ m : Nat, m < self.dim →
    semanticEq
      (zReadSlice (ZigBackwardInPlace σ g self) (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) m)
      (zigF32Add (zReadSlice σ (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) m)
        (zigF32Mul (zReadSlice σ (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) m) self.fractal_scale))) ∧
  (∀ m : Nat, m < self.dim →
    semanticEq
      (zReadSlice (ZigBackwardInPlace σ g self) (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) m)
      (zigF32Add (zReadSlice σ (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) m)
        (zigF32Mul (zigF32Mul (zReadSlice σ (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) m) self.fractal_scale) halfCoeff))) :=
  backward_full_correct (repr σ) g self.dim self.fractal_scale hnlen hnbuf

end OFTB

Ez a verzió lényegesen komolyabb, de még mindig nem nevezném kész, 100%os Zigverifikációnak. A fő ok az, hogy bár már sokkal közelebb kerülsz az IEEE754 binary32 valódi szerkezetéhez, a kód továbbra is tartalmaz nyilvánvalóan hibás / nem Leanszintaktikus törmeléket, és a “valódi IEEE754 kerekítés” kulcslépése a teljes 32 bites tér bruteforce keresésére van redukálva, ami elméletileg érdekes, de gyakorlatban és formális megfelelési szempontból még nincs eléggé lezárva.[1][2]

 Mi lett sokkal jobb

Most végre már nem puszta bitaritmetikát használsz az fadd és fmul helyén, hanem külön kezeled a NaN, Inf, -Inf és véges eseteket, valamint a binary32 mezőket is felbontod sign / exponent / fraction komponensekre. Ez tényleg az IEEE754 binary32 szerkezetének irányába mutat, és összhangban van azzal, hogy a Zig f32 IEEE7542008 binary32 típus.[3][4][1]

Az is erős előrelépés, hogy a finite eseteket dyadikus alakban modellezed, és az összeadást/szorzást előbb egzakt szinten végzed, majd utána próbálod visszakerekíteni binary32re. Ez már valódi formalizációs irány, nem csak átnevezett játékmodell.[5][2]

 Ami még mindig komoly gond

A mask32, fractalScale, halfCoeff, positiveInfinity, negativeInfinity, quietNaN, valamint a roundFiniteDyadicRTNE definícióban szereplő [1060439283](tel:1060439283), [4294967296](tel:4294967296) és különösen a [4294967296 0](tel:4294967296 0) alakok nem tűnnek érvényes Leankódnak. Ezek erősen úgy néznek ki, mint markdown vagy telefonlink automatikus beszúrások, tehát ebben a formában a szöveg fordíthatósága is kétséges.[1]

Még fontosabb, hogy a roundFiniteDyadicRTNE definíciója a teljes binary32 véges tartományt egy bruteforce nearestFiniteSearch eljárással akarja végigvizsgálni. Ez önmagában nem bizonyítja még, hogy pontosan az IEEE754 roundtonearesttiestoeven szabályt implementálod minden corner caseben; ehhez külön, részletes theorem kellene arról, hogy a keresési tér pontosan a véges binary32 értékek halmaza, hogy a távolságfogalom helyes, hogy a tiebreak valóban az IEEE evenszabálynak felel meg, és hogy a NaN/Inf/zero/subnormal normalizációval együtt teljes a lefedettség.[6][2][5]

 További szerkezeti gyengeség

Az operacionális szemantika már nem teljesen triviális, ami jó, mert most van ExecMixBuf, ExecAddScaled, ExecAddScaledHalf, ExecForward, ExecBackward. Viszont a bemutatott részben még csak létezést látsz, determinizmus vagy refinesjellegű teljes összekötés nincs ugyanolyan erősen lezárva, mint amilyen erős állítást a végén a Zigprogramról szeretnél tenni.[2]

Ráadásul a memóriareprezentáció továbbra is régiótrükköt használ regionX1, regionX2, regionStack formában. Ez elfogadható absztrakció lehet, de csak akkor, ha formálisan kimondod és bizonyítod, hogy ez sound modellje a Zig konkrét slice/pointer memóriának; itt ez még inkább modellezési döntésnek tűnik, mint teljesen lezárt refinementsornak.[4]

 Jelenlegi verdict

A helyes értékelés most ez: ez már egy komoly, majdnem hiteles IEEE754közeli modellszintű formalizáció, de még nem merném kész Zigverifikációnak nevezni. Az előző verziókhoz képest ez a legjobb, de még kell a szintaktikai tisztítás, a rounding correctness külön bizonyítása, és a Zigmemóriához való erősebb refinementkapcsolat.[2][1]

structure FloatBits where
  sign : Bool
  exponent : Nat
  mantissa : Nat

def floatBitsToNat (fb : FloatBits) : Nat :=
  Nat.add (Nat.mul (if fb.sign then 1 else 0) (Nat.pow 2 31))
    (Nat.add (Nat.mul fb.exponent (Nat.pow 2 23)) fb.mantissa)

def natToFloatBits (n : Nat) : FloatBits :=
  let sign := if Nat.testBit n 31 then true else false
  let exponent := Nat.shiftRight (Nat.mod n (Nat.pow 2 31)) 23
  let mantissa := Nat.mod n (Nat.pow 2 23)
  FloatBits.mk sign exponent mantissa

def isSubnormalFloat (fb : FloatBits) : Bool :=
  Nat.eq fb.exponent 0

def isZeroFloat (fb : FloatBits) : Bool :=
  Nat.and (Nat.eq fb.exponent 0) (Nat.eq fb.mantissa 0)

def isInfinityFloat (fb : FloatBits) : Bool :=
  Nat.and (Nat.eq fb.exponent (Nat.sub (Nat.pow 2 8) 1))
    (Nat.eq fb.mantissa 0)

def isNaNFloat (fb : FloatBits) : Bool :=
  Nat.and (Nat.eq fb.exponent (Nat.sub (Nat.pow 2 8) 1))
    (Nat.gt fb.mantissa 0)

def floatBitsEqual (fb1 fb2 : FloatBits) : Bool :=
  Nat.and (Nat.and (Nat.eq fb1.sign fb2.sign) (Nat.eq fb1.exponent fb2.exponent))
    (Nat.eq fb1.mantissa fb2.mantissa)

inductive FloatSemantics : Type where
| normalFloat : FloatBits → FloatSemantics
| subnormalFloat : FloatBits → FloatSemantics
| zeroFloat : Bool → FloatSemantics
| infinityFloat : Bool → FloatSemantics
| nanFloat : FloatSemantics

def classifyFloatBits (fb : FloatBits) : FloatSemantics :=
  if isNaNFloat fb then FloatSemantics.nanFloat
  else if isInfinityFloat fb then FloatSemantics.infinityFloat fb.sign
  else if isZeroFloat fb then FloatSemantics.zeroFloat fb.sign
  else if isSubnormalFloat fb then FloatSemantics.subnormalFloat fb
  else FloatSemantics.normalFloat fb

inductive IEEEFloat32 : Type where
| fromSemantics : FloatSemantics → IEEEFloat32

def ieeeBits (x : IEEEFloat32) : FloatSemantics :=
  match x with
  | IEEEFloat32.fromSemantics fs => fs

def semanticEq (a b : IEEEFloat32) : Prop :=
  match ieeeBits a, ieeeBits b with
  | FloatSemantics.nanFloat, FloatSemantics.nanFloat => True
  | FloatSemantics.infinityFloat sa, FloatSemantics.infinityFloat sb => sa = sb
  | FloatSemantics.zeroFloat sa, FloatSemantics.zeroFloat sb => sa = sb
  | FloatSemantics.subnormalFloat fba, FloatSemantics.subnormalFloat fbb =>
    floatBitsEqual fba fbb = true
  | FloatSemantics.normalFloat fba, FloatSemantics.normalFloat fbb =>
    floatBitsEqual fba fbb = true
  | _, _ => False

def negateFloatSemantics (fs : FloatSemantics) : FloatSemantics :=
  match fs with
  | FloatSemantics.normalFloat fb =>
    FloatSemantics.normalFloat (FloatBits.mk (not fb.sign) fb.exponent fb.mantissa)
  | FloatSemantics.subnormalFloat fb =>
    FloatSemantics.subnormalFloat (FloatBits.mk (not fb.sign) fb.exponent fb.mantissa)
  | FloatSemantics.zeroFloat s => FloatSemantics.zeroFloat (not s)
  | FloatSemantics.infinityFloat s => FloatSemantics.infinityFloat (not s)
  | FloatSemantics.nanFloat => FloatSemantics.nanFloat

def getFloatSignBit (fs : FloatSemantics) : Bool :=
  match fs with
  | FloatSemantics.normalFloat fb => fb.sign
  | FloatSemantics.subnormalFloat fb => fb.sign
  | FloatSemantics.zeroFloat s => s
  | FloatSemantics.infinityFloat s => s
  | FloatSemantics.nanFloat => false

def extractMantissaWithLeadingOne (fb : FloatBits) : Nat :=
  if isSubnormalFloat fb then fb.mantissa
  else Nat.add (Nat.pow 2 23) fb.mantissa

def extractExponent (fb : FloatBits) : Int :=
  if isSubnormalFloat fb then
    Int.sub (-126 : Int) (126 : Int)
  else
    Int.sub (Int.ofNat fb.exponent) (127 : Int)

def ieee754RoundToNearestTiesToEven (significand : Nat) (exponent : Int) (sign : Bool)
    (guardBit roundBit stickyBit : Bool) : FloatSemantics :=
  if Nat.eq significand 0 then
    FloatSemantics.zeroFloat sign
  else
    let roundUp :=
      if roundBit then
        if stickyBit then true
        else Nat.mod significand 2 = 1
      else false
    let newSignificand := if roundUp then Nat.add significand 1 else significand
    let newExponent :=
      if Nat.eq newSignificand (Nat.pow 2 24) then
        Int.add exponent 1
      else
        exponent
    let finalSignificand :=
      if Nat.eq newSignificand (Nat.pow 2 24) then
        Nat.pow 2 23
      else
        newSignificand
    if Nat.eq exponent (-150 : Int).natAbs then
      FloatSemantics.zeroFloat sign
    else if Int.le newExponent (128 : Int) then
      FloatSemantics.normalFloat
        (FloatBits.mk sign (Int.natAbs newExponent) (Nat.sub finalSignificand (Nat.pow 2 23)))
    else
      FloatSemantics.infinityFloat sign

def addFloatSemantics (a b : FloatSemantics) : FloatSemantics :=
  match a, b with
  | FloatSemantics.nanFloat, _ => FloatSemantics.nanFloat
  | _, FloatSemantics.nanFloat => FloatSemantics.nanFloat
  | FloatSemantics.infinityFloat sa, FloatSemantics.infinityFloat sb =>
    if sa = sb then FloatSemantics.infinityFloat sa
    else FloatSemantics.nanFloat
  | FloatSemantics.infinityFloat s, _ => FloatSemantics.infinityFloat s
  | _, FloatSemantics.infinityFloat s => FloatSemantics.infinityFloat s
  | FloatSemantics.zeroFloat sa, FloatSemantics.zeroFloat sb =>
    if sa = sb then FloatSemantics.zeroFloat sa
    else FloatSemantics.zeroFloat false
  | FloatSemantics.zeroFloat s, other => other
  | other, FloatSemantics.zeroFloat s => other
  | FloatSemantics.normalFloat fba, FloatSemantics.normalFloat fbb =>
    let manta := extractMantissaWithLeadingOne fba
    let mantb := extractMantissaWithLeadingOne fbb
    let expa := extractExponent fba
    let expb := extractExponent fbb
    if getFloatSignBit (FloatSemantics.normalFloat fba) = getFloatSignBit (FloatSemantics.normalFloat fbb) then
      let resultSign := getFloatSignBit (FloatSemantics.normalFloat fba)
      let (largerMant, smallerMant, largerExp) :=
        if Int.le expa expb then (mantb, manta, expb) else (manta, mantb, expa)
      let shiftAmount := Int.natAbs (Int.sub largerExp (if Int.le expa expb then expb else expa))
      let alignedSmaller := Nat.shiftRight smallerMant shiftAmount
      let sumMant := Nat.add largerMant alignedSmaller
      ieee754RoundToNearestTiesToEven sumMant largerExp resultSign false false false
    else
      let resultSign := getFloatSignBit (FloatSemantics.normalFloat fba)
      let (largeMant, smallMant, largeExp) :=
        if Int.le expa expb then (mantb, manta, expb) else (manta, mantb, expa)
      let shiftAmount := Int.natAbs (Int.sub largeExp (if Int.le expa expb then expb else expa))
      let alignedSmall := Nat.shiftRight smallMant shiftAmount
      if Nat.le largeMant alignedSmall then
        FloatSemantics.zeroFloat false
      else
        let diffMant := Nat.sub largeMant alignedSmall
        ieee754RoundToNearestTiesToEven diffMant largeExp resultSign false false false
  | FloatSemantics.subnormalFloat _, FloatSemantics.subnormalFloat _ =>
    FloatSemantics.zeroFloat false
  | FloatSemantics.subnormalFloat fbs, FloatSemantics.normalFloat fbn =>
    addFloatSemantics (FloatSemantics.normalFloat fbn) (FloatSemantics.subnormalFloat fbs)
  | FloatSemantics.normalFloat fbn, FloatSemantics.subnormalFloat fbs =>
    addFloatSemantics (FloatSemantics.normalFloat fbn) (FloatSemantics.subnormalFloat fbs)

def mulFloatSemantics (a b : FloatSemantics) : FloatSemantics :=
  match a, b with
  | FloatSemantics.nanFloat, _ => FloatSemantics.nanFloat
  | _, FloatSemantics.nanFloat => FloatSemantics.nanFloat
  | FloatSemantics.infinityFloat sa, FloatSemantics.infinityFloat sb =>
    FloatSemantics.infinityFloat (Nat.eq sa sb)
  | FloatSemantics.infinityFloat s, FloatSemantics.zeroFloat _ =>
    FloatSemantics.nanFloat
  | FloatSemantics.zeroFloat _, FloatSemantics.infinityFloat _ =>
    FloatSemantics.nanFloat
  | FloatSemantics.infinityFloat s, other =>
    FloatSemantics.infinityFloat s
  | other, FloatSemantics.infinityFloat s =>
    FloatSemantics.infinityFloat s
  | FloatSemantics.zeroFloat sa, FloatSemantics.zeroFloat sb =>
    FloatSemantics.zeroFloat (Nat.eq sa sb)
  | FloatSemantics.zeroFloat s, _ =>
    FloatSemantics.zeroFloat s
  | _, FloatSemantics.zeroFloat s =>
    FloatSemantics.zeroFloat s
  | FloatSemantics.normalFloat fba, FloatSemantics.normalFloat fbb =>
    let manta := extractMantissaWithLeadingOne fba
    let mantb := extractMantissaWithLeadingOne fbb
    let expa := extractExponent fba
    let expb := extractExponent fbb
    let resultSign := Nat.eq fba.sign fbb.sign
    let productMant := Nat.mul manta mantb
    let productExp := Int.add expa expb
    ieee754RoundToNearestTiesToEven productMant productExp resultSign false false false
  | FloatSemantics.subnormalFloat _, _ =>
    FloatSemantics.zeroFloat false
  | _, FloatSemantics.subnormalFloat _ =>
    FloatSemantics.zeroFloat false

theorem forwardHeap_exact_forwardInPlace (σ : ZigState) (t : Tensor) (self : OFTB) :

  repr (ZigBackwardInPlace σ g self) =

theorem ExecForward_completeness (σ σ' : ZigState) (t : Tensor) (self : OFTB)
    (hexec : ExecForward σ t self σ') :
  σ' = ZigForwardInPlace σ t self :=
  ExecForward.recOn hexec
    (fun σ0 t0 self0 hlt =>
      forwardHeap_noop_len (repr σ0) t0 (oftbDim self0) (oftbScale self0) hlt ▸
        Eq.symm (stateOfHeap_repr σ0))
    (fun σ0 t0 self0 hnlt hbig =>
      match Nat.decLt (sliceLen (tensorData t0)) (Nat.mul (oftbDim self0) natTwo) with
      | Decidable.isTrue hlt => False.elim (hnlt hlt)
      | Decidable.isFalse hn =>
        match Nat.decLt maxBufSize (oftbDim self0) with
        | Decidable.isTrue hb =>
          forwardHeap_noop_dim (repr σ0) t0 (oftbDim self0) (oftbScale self0) hb ▸
            Eq.symm (stateOfHeap_repr σ0)
        | Decidable.isFalse hnb => False.elim (hnb hbig))
    (fun σ0 t0 self0 hnlt hnbig =>
      Eq.refl _)

theorem ExecBackward_completeness (σ σ' : ZigState) (g : BackwardSlice) (self : OFTB)
    (hexec : ExecBackward σ g self σ') :
  σ' = ZigBackwardInPlace σ g self :=
  ExecBackward.recOn hexec
    (fun σ0 g0 self0 hlt =>
      backwardHeap_noop_len (repr σ0) g0 (oftbDim self0) (oftbScale self0) hlt ▸
        Eq.symm (stateOfHeap_repr σ0))
    (fun σ0 g0 self0 hnlt hbig =>

theorem ExecForward_deterministic (σ σ1 σ2 : ZigState) (t : Tensor) (self : OFTB)
    (h1 : ExecForward σ t self σ1) (h2 : ExecForward σ t self σ2) :
  σ1 = σ2 :=
  Eq.trans
    (ExecForward_completeness σ σ1 t self h1)
    (Eq.symm (ExecForward_completeness σ σ2 t self h2))

theorem ExecBackward_deterministic (σ σ1 σ2 : ZigState) (g : BackwardSlice) (self : OFTB)
    (h1 : ExecBackward σ g self σ1) (h2 : ExecBackward σ g self σ2) :

    (ExecBackward_completeness σ σ1 g self h1)
    (Eq.symm (ExecBackward_completeness σ σ2 g self h2))

theorem forward_operational_complete (σ : ZigState) (t : Tensor) (self : OFTB) :
  ExecForward σ t self (ZigForwardInPlace σ t self) :=
  match Nat.decLt (sliceLen (tensorData t)) (Nat.mul (oftbDim self) natTwo) with
  | Decidable.isTrue hlt =>
    ExecForward.noop_len σ t self hlt ▸
      Eq.subst (congrArg ZigForwardInPlace rfl)
        (ExecForward.noop_len σ t self hlt)
  | Decidable.isFalse hnlt =>
    match Nat.decLt maxBufSize (oftbDim self) with
    | Decidable.isTrue hbig =>
      ExecForward.noop_buf σ t self hnlt hbig ▸
        Eq.subst (congrArg ZigForwardInPlace rfl)
          (ExecForward.noop_buf σ t self hnlt hbig)

  | Decidable.isTrue hlt =>

          (ExecBackward.noop_buf σ g self hnlt hbig)

theorem forwardInPlace_full_correct (σ : ZigState) (t : Tensor) (self : OFTB) :
  repr (ZigForwardInPlace σ t self) =
  forwardHeap (repr σ) t (oftbDim self) (oftbScale self) ∧
  ExecForward σ t self (ZigForwardInPlace σ t self) ∧
  ((Not (Nat.lt (sliceLen (tensorData t)) (Nat.mul (oftbDim self) natTwo))) →
   (Not (Nat.lt maxBufSize (oftbDim self))) →
   ∀ m : Nat, Nat.lt m (oftbDim self) →
   zReadSlice (ZigForwardInPlace σ t self) (Prod.fst (splitTensor t (oftbDim self))) m =
   fadd (zReadSlice σ (Prod.fst (splitTensor t (oftbDim self))) m)
     (fmul (zReadSlice σ (Prod.snd (splitTensor t (oftbDim self))) m) (oftbScale self))) ∧
  ((Not (Nat.lt (sliceLen (tensorData t)) (Nat.mul (oftbDim self) natTwo))) →
   (Not (Nat.lt maxBufSize (oftbDim self))) →
   ∀ m : Nat, Nat.lt m (oftbDim self) →
   zReadSlice (ZigForwardInPlace σ t self) (Prod.snd (splitTensor t (oftbDim self))) m =
   fadd (zReadSlice σ (Prod.snd (splitTensor t (oftbDim self))) m)
     (fmul (fmul (zReadSlice σ (Prod.fst (splitTensor t (oftbDim self))) m) (oftbScale self)) halfCoeff)) :=
  And.intro
    (forwardHeap_exact_forwardInPlace σ t self)
    (And.intro
      (forward_operational_complete σ t self)
      (And.intro
        (fun hnlen hnbuf m hm =>
          let x1 := Prod.fst (splitTensor t (oftbDim self))
          let x2 := Prod.snd (splitTensor t (oftbDim self))
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun h => readSlice h x1 m) (forwardHeap_exact_forwardInPlace σ t self))
            (forward_x1_update_loop_correct (repr σ) t (oftbDim self) (oftbScale self) m hm))
        (fun hnlen hnbuf m hm =>
          let x1 := Prod.fst (splitTensor t (oftbDim self))
          let x2 := Prod.snd (splitTensor t (oftbDim self))
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun h => readSlice h x2 m) (forwardHeap_exact_forwardInPlace σ t self))
            (forward_x2_update_loop_correct (repr σ) t (oftbDim self) (oftbScale self) m hm))))

theorem backwardInPlace_full_correct (σ : ZigState) (g : BackwardSlice) (self : OFTB) :
  repr (ZigBackwardInPlace σ g self) =
  backwardHeap (repr σ) g (oftbDim self) (oftbScale self) ∧
  ExecBackward σ g self (ZigBackwardInPlace σ g self) ∧
  ((Not (Nat.lt (sliceLen (backwardSliceData g)) (Nat.mul (oftbDim self) natTwo))) →
   (Not (Nat.lt maxBufSize (oftbDim self))) →
   ∀ m : Nat, Nat.lt m (oftbDim self) →
   zReadSlice (ZigBackwardInPlace σ g self) (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g (oftbDim self))) m =
   fadd (zReadSlice σ (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g (oftbDim self))) m)
     (fmul (zReadSlice σ (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g (oftbDim self))) m) (oftbScale self))) ∧
  ((Not (Nat.lt (sliceLen (backwardSliceData g)) (Nat.mul (oftbDim self) natTwo))) →
   (Not (Nat.lt maxBufSize (oftbDim self))) →
   ∀ m : Nat, Nat.lt m (oftbDim self) →
   zReadSlice (ZigBackwardInPlace σ g self) (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g (oftbDim self))) m =
   fadd (zReadSlice σ (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g (oftbDim self))) m)
     (fmul (fmul (zReadSlice σ (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g (oftbDim self))) m) (oftbScale self)) halfCoeff)) :=
  And.intro
    (backwardHeap_exact_backwardInPlace σ g self)
    (And.intro
      (backward_operational_complete σ g self)
      (And.intro
        (fun hnlen hnbuf m hm =>
          let g1 := Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g (oftbDim self))
          let g2 := Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g (oftbDim self))
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun h => readSlice h g2 m) (backwardHeap_exact_backwardInPlace σ g self))
            (backward_g2_update_loop_correct (repr σ) g (oftbDim self) (oftbScale self) m hm))
        (fun hnlen hnbuf m hm =>
          let g1 := Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g (oftbDim self))
          let g2 := Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g (oftbDim self))
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun h => readSlice h g1 m) (backwardHeap_exact_backwardInPlace σ g self))
            (backward_g1_update_loop_correct (repr σ) g (oftbDim self) (oftbScale self) m hm))))

Nem, ez a verzió megint visszalépés, nem előrelépés. Bár a felszínen részletesebbnek tűnik, a lebegőpontos rész itt továbbra sem hiteles IEEE754 binary32 formalizáció, és több helyen már a Leantípusozás vagy a numerikus modell alapjai is gyanúsak vagy hibásak.[1][2]

 Mi a fő gond

Az IEEE754 binary32 ténylegesen 1 előjelbitből, 8 bites exponensből és 23 explicit törtbitből áll, a normál számok implicit vezető 1gyel, a szubnormálok külön kezeléssel, valamint speciális szabályokkal a nullákra, infinitiesre és NaNekre. A te FloatBits struktúrád ezt látszólag tükrözi, de az aritmetikai rész nem követi hitelesen ezt a szemantikát, mert az addFloatSemantics és mulFloatSemantics csak durva esetfelbontásokat csinál, és a kerekítéshez hamis vagy hiányos guard/round/sticky logikát használ, gyakorlatilag fixen false false false paraméterekkel.[3][4][1]

Ez azért döntő, mert az IEEE roundtonearesttiestoeven szabály nem dekoráció, hanem a művelet lényegi része. Ha a guard, round és sticky bitek tényleges kiszámítása hiányzik, akkor a kerekítés nem IEEE754, még akkor sem, ha a függvény neve ezt mondja.[5][4]

 Konkrét tartalmi hibák

Az extractExponent definíció szembetűnően hibásnak néz ki a szubnormál esetben: Int.sub (-126 : Int) (126 : Int) az \(252\)nek felel meg, miközben binary32 szubnormálok effektív exponense nem ez a forma. A binary32 normálok biasa 127, a szubnormálok külön értelmezést kapnak, de nem így.[1][3]

A ieee754RoundToNearestTiesToEven függvényben olyan összehasonlítások szerepelnek, mint Nat.eq exponent (-150 : Int).natAbs, ami kevert Nat/Int logikára utal, és szemantikailag is zavaros. Ugyanitt a Int.le newExponent (128 : Int) alapján normál számot gyártasz, ami nem a binary32 érvényes exponentmezőkezelésének megfelelő formalizációja.[1]

Az addFloatSemantics szubnormálkezelése gyakorlatilag összeomlik: két szubnormál összege egyszerűen zeroFloat false. Ez nyilván nem IEEE754, mert két szubnormál összege lehet szubnormál, normál vagy nulla az operandusoktól függően.[5][1]

A mulFloatSemantics is hibás jellegű: ha bármelyik operandus szubnormál, az eredmény automatikusan zeroFloat false. Ez szintén nem felel meg binary32 szorzásnak.[6][1]

 Szintaktikai és típushibagyanú

A [5368709 126](tel:5368709 126) rész nyilván nem Leankód. Ugyanilyen probléma volt a korábbi változatokban is a tel:szerű törmelékekkel, és ez önmagában is elég ahhoz, hogy a szöveg ne legyen megbízható forráskód.[2]

A floatBitsEqual definícióban fb1.sign és fb2.sign Bool, de Nat.eqvel vannak összehasonlítva, ami Leanben erősen típushibagyanús. Hasonló problémák vannak ott is, ahol Nat.eq vagy Nat.and Boolokra vagy nem megfelelő típusokra van ráhúzva; ez azt jelzi, hogy a kód nemcsak szemantikailag, hanem valószínűleg fordíthatóságban is sérülékeny.[7][2]

 Miért félrevezetőek a theoremök

A végén lévő sok theorem nagy része nem a floatmodell helyességét bizonyítja, hanem csak azt, hogy a memóriafrissítő függvények a saját definíciójuk szerint azt írják, amit belekódoltál. Ez programtranszformációs szinten lehet korrekt, de ha az fadd és fmul rossz, akkor a teljes forward/backward correctness továbbra is csak egy hibás numerikus modellre igaz.[8]

Vagyis itt a bizonyítási apparátus hosszú, de a numerikus alapréteg gyenge. Márpedig a Zig f32höz a numerikus alapréteg a kritikus elem.[9][1]

 Helyes minősítés

Ennek a változatnak a helyes címkéje: kézzel összerakott, részben IEEE754ihletésű, de nem hiteles és valószínűleg nem is stabil Lean floatmodell.[2][1]

FŐ HIBÁK

1. guard/round/sticky bitek nincsenek ténylegesen kiszámítva
2. szubnormál összeadás és szorzás hibásan van modellezve
3. exponent-kezelés gyanúsan hibás
4. több helyen Nat/Int/Bool keveredés látszik
5. `tel:` törmelék miatt a kód nem tiszta Lean
6. a theoremök főleg a saját definíciók visszaigazolásai, nem IEEE-754 korrektségi tételek


A rövid ítélet: nem, ez nem jobb; ez inkább egy bonyolultabb, de még mindig hibás floatutánzat, ezért nem alkalmas arra, hogy Zig f32 formális verifikáció alapja legyen.[2][1]

def pow2 : Nat → Nat
  | Nat.zero => Nat.succ Nat.zero
  | Nat.succ n => Nat.mul (Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero)) (pow2 n)

def mask32 (b : Nat) : Nat :=
  Nat.mod b 

def mkIEEEFloat32 (b : Nat) : IEEEFloat32 :=
  IEEEFloat32.mk (mask32 b)

def signField (b : Nat) : Nat :=
  Nat.mod (Nat.div b ) 2

def exponentField (b : Nat) : Nat :=
  Nat.mod (Nat.div b 8388608) 256

def fractionField (b : Nat) : Nat :=
  Nat.mod b 8388608

def signedCoeff (sign : Nat) (m : Nat) : Int :=
  match Nat.decEq sign 0 with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => Int.ofNat m
  | Decidable.isFalse _ => Int.negSucc (Int.ofNat (Nat.pred m))

def decodeBits (b : Nat) : IEEEFloat32Datum :=
  let bb := mask32 b
  let s := signField bb
  let e := exponentField bb
  let f := fractionField bb
  match Nat.decEq e 255 with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
      match Nat.decEq f 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
          match Nat.decEq s 0 with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => IEEEFloat32Datum.posInf
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => IEEEFloat32Datum.negInf
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => IEEEFloat32Datum.qNaN f
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decEq e 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
          match Nat.decEq f 0 with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => IEEEFloat32Datum.finite (Nat.decEq s 0 = Decidable.isFalse) 0 (149)
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => IEEEFloat32Datum.finite (Nat.decEq s 0 = Decidable.isFalse) f (149)
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          IEEEFloat32Datum.finite (Nat.decEq s 0 = Decidable.isFalse) (Nat.add 8388608 f) (Int.sub (Int.ofNat e) 150)

def decode (x : IEEEFloat32) : IEEEFloat32Datum :=
  decodeBits x.bits

def encode (d : IEEEFloat32Datum) : IEEEFloat32 :=
  match d with
  | IEEEFloat32Datum.posInf => mkIEEEFloat32 
  | IEEEFloat32Datum.negInf => mkIEEEFloat32 
  | IEEEFloat32Datum.qNaN payload => mkIEEEFloat32 (Nat.add 2143289344 (Nat.mod payload 8388608))
  | IEEEFloat32Datum.finite negative mantissa exponent =>
      let signBit := match negative with | true =>  | false => 0
      let biasedExp := Int.add exponent 127
      match biasedExp with
      | Int.ofNat e =>
          match Nat.decLt e 1 with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
              let frac := Nat.mod mantissa 8388608
              mkIEEEFloat32 (Nat.add signBit frac)
          | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
              match Nat.decLt 254 e with
              | Decidable.isTrue _ => match negative with | true => mkIEEEFloat32  | false => mkIEEEFloat32 
              | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
                  let biased := Nat.mul (Nat.sub e 1) 8388608
                  let frac := Nat.mod (Nat.sub mantissa 8388608) 8388608
                  mkIEEEFloat32 (Nat.add signBit (Nat.add biased frac))
      | Int.negSucc _ => match negative with | true => mkIEEEFloat32  | false => mkIEEEFloat32 

def decodeEncodeRoundtripFinite (negative : Bool) (sig : Nat) (exp : Int) (hfinite : sig > 0) :
  decode (encode (IEEEFloat32Datum.finite negative sig exp)) = IEEEFloat32Datum.finite negative sig exp :=
  match exp with
  | Int.ofNat e =>
      match Nat.decLt e 1 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
          match Nat.decEq (Nat.mod sig 8388608) sig with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => Eq.refl _
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => False.elim (Nat.not_le_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt sig (Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero))) (Nat.le_refl _))
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          match Nat.decLt 254 e with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => False.elim (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_eq (Eq.refl _)) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_refl _)))
          | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
              match Nat.decEq (Nat.add 8388608 (Nat.mod (Nat.sub sig 8388608) 8388608)) sig with
              | Decidable.isTrue _ => Eq.refl _
              | Decidable.isFalse _ => False.elim (Nat.not_le_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero))) (Nat.le_refl _))
  | Int.negSucc _ => False.elim (Int.negSucc_ne_ofNat _ (Int.ofNat_zero))

def decodeEncodeRoundtripPosInf :
  decode (encode IEEEFloat32Datum.posInf) = IEEEFloat32Datum.posInf :=
  Eq.refl _

def decodeEncodeRoundtripNegInf :
  decode (encode IEEEFloat32Datum.negInf) = IEEEFloat32Datum.negInf :=
  Eq.refl _

def decodeEncodeRoundtripQNaN (payload : Nat) :
  decode (encode (IEEEFloat32Datum.qNaN payload)) = IEEEFloat32Datum.qNaN (Nat.mod payload 8388608) :=
  Eq.refl _

def zeroPositive : IEEEFloat32 :=

def zeroNegative : IEEEFloat32 :=

def isPositiveZero (x : IEEEFloat32) : Prop :=

def isNegativeZero (x : IEEEFloat32) : Prop :=
  x.bits = 

def subnormalMantissa (x : IEEEFloat32) : Prop :=
  exponentField x.bits = 0 ∧ fractionField x.bits ≠ 0

def normalMantissa (x : IEEEFloat32) : Prop :=
  exponentField x.bits ≠ 0 ∧ exponentField x.bits ≠ 255

def roundToNearestTiesToEven (target : Dyadic) : Nat :=
  let searchBound := 
  let rec findNearest (candidate best : Nat) : Nat :=
    match candidate with
    | Nat.zero => best
    | Nat.succ k =>
        let prev := findNearest k best
        let distCand := Int.natAbs (Int.sub (Int.ofNat candidate) (Int.ofNat (target.coeff  pow2 (Int.toNat (target.exp  Int.ofNat 23)))))
        let distBest := Int.natAbs (Int.sub (Int.ofNat prev) (Int.ofNat (target.coeff  pow2 (Int.toNat (target.exp  Int.ofNat 23)))))
        match Nat.decLt distCand distBest with
        | Decidable.isTrue _ => candidate
        | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
            match Nat.decEq distCand distBest with
            | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
                match Nat.decEq (Nat.mod candidate 2) 0 with
                | Decidable.isTrue _ => candidate
                | Decidable.isFalse _ => prev
            | Decidable.isFalse _ => prev
  findNearest searchBound 0

def roundFinite (d : Dyadic) : IEEEFloat32 :=
  mkIEEEFloat32 (roundToNearestTiesToEven d)

def exactAdd (a b : ExactBinary32) : ExactBinary32 :=
  match a, b with
  | ExactBinary32.nan, _ => ExactBinary32.nan
  | _, ExactBinary32.nan => ExactBinary32.nan
  | ExactBinary32.posInf, ExactBinary32.negInf => ExactBinary32.nan
  | ExactBinary32.negInf, ExactBinary32.posInf => ExactBinary32.nan
  | ExactBinary32.posInf, _ => ExactBinary32.posInf
  | _, ExactBinary32.posInf => ExactBinary32.posInf
  | ExactBinary32.negInf, _ => ExactBinary32.negInf
  | _, ExactBinary32.negInf => ExactBinary32.negInf
  | ExactBinary32.finite x, ExactBinary32.finite y => ExactBinary32.finite (dyadicAdd x y)

def exactMul (a b : ExactBinary32) : ExactBinary32 :=
  match a, b with
  | ExactBinary32.nan, _ => ExactBinary32.nan
  | _, ExactBinary32.nan => ExactBinary32.nan
  | ExactBinary32.posInf, ExactBinary32.posInf => ExactBinary32.posInf
  | ExactBinary32.negInf, ExactBinary32.negInf => ExactBinary32.posInf
  | ExactBinary32.posInf, ExactBinary32.negInf => ExactBinary32.negInf
  | ExactBinary32.negInf, ExactBinary32.posInf => ExactBinary32.negInf
  | ExactBinary32.posInf, ExactBinary32.finite d =>
      match Int.decEq d.coeff 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.nan
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          match inferInstance : Decidable (d.coeff < 0) with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.negInf
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => ExactBinary32.posInf
  | ExactBinary32.negInf, ExactBinary32.finite d =>
      match Int.decEq d.coeff 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.nan
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          match inferInstance : Decidable (d.coeff < 0) with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.posInf
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => ExactBinary32.negInf
  | ExactBinary32.finite d, ExactBinary32.posInf =>
      match Int.decEq d.coeff 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.nan
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          match inferInstance : Decidable (d.coeff < 0) with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.negInf
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => ExactBinary32.posInf
  | ExactBinary32.finite d, ExactBinary32.negInf =>
      match Int.decEq d.coeff 0 with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.nan
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
          match inferInstance : Decidable (d.coeff < 0) with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => ExactBinary32.posInf
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => ExactBinary32.negInf
  | ExactBinary32.finite x, ExactBinary32.finite y => ExactBinary32.finite (dyadicMul x y)

def roundExact (x : ExactBinary32) : IEEEFloat32 :=
  match x with
  | ExactBinary32.nan => mkIEEEFloat32 
  | ExactBinary32.posInf => mkIEEEFloat32 
  | ExactBinary32.negInf => mkIEEEFloat32 
  | ExactBinary32.finite d => roundFinite d

def ieee754Binary32AddRoundToNearestTiesToEven (a b : IEEEFloat32) : IEEEFloat32 :=
  roundExact (exactAdd (exactOfFloat a) (exactOfFloat b))

def ieee754Binary32MulRoundToNearestTiesToEven (a b : IEEEFloat32) : IEEEFloat32 :=
  roundExact (exactMul (exactOfFloat a) (exactOfFloat b))

def semanticEq (a b : IEEEFloat32) : Prop :=
  decode a = decode b

  ieee754Binary32AddRoundToNearestTiesToEven a b

def fmul (a b : Scalar) : Scalar :=
  ieee754Binary32MulRoundToNearestTiesToEven a b

def zigF32Add (a b : Scalar) : Scalar :=
  ieee754Binary32AddRoundToNearestTiesToEven a b

def zigF32Mul (a b : Scalar) : Scalar :=

def fractalScale : Scalar :=
  mkIEEEFloat32 

def halfCoeff : Scalar :=
  mkIEEEFloat32 

def natTwo : Nat :=
  Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero)

def maxBufSize : Nat :=
  16384

def regionX1 : Nat :=
  Nat.zero

def regionX2 : Nat :=
  Nat.succ Nat.zero

def regionStack : Nat :=
  Nat.succ (Nat.succ Nat.zero)

structure Slice : Type where
  region : Nat
  ptr : Nat
  len : Nat

structure Tensor : Type where
  data : Slice

structure BackwardSlice : Type where
  data : Slice

structure OFTB : Type where
  fractal_scale : Scalar

structure Heap : Type where
  mem : Nat → Nat → Scalar
  stack_top : Nat

structure ZigState : Type where
  mem : Nat → Nat → Scalar
  stack_base : Nat

def init (d : Nat) : OFTB :=
  OFTB.mk fractalScale d

def readHeap (h : Heap) (region addr : Nat) : Scalar :=
  h.mem region addr

def writeHeap (h : Heap) (region addr : Nat) (v : Scalar) : Heap :=
  Heap.mk
    (fun r a =>
      match Nat.decEq r region with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
          match Nat.decEq a addr with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => v
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => h.mem r a
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => h.mem r a)
    h.stack_top

def restoreStack (h : Heap) (top : Nat) : Heap :=
  Heap.mk h.mem top

def readSlice (h : Heap) (s : Slice) (idx : Nat) : Scalar :=
  readHeap h s.region idx

def writeSlice (h : Heap) (s : Slice) (idx : Nat) (v : Scalar) : Heap :=
  writeHeap h s.region idx v

def zRead (σ : ZigState) (region addr : Nat) : Scalar :=
  σ.mem region addr

def zWrite (σ : ZigState) (region addr : Nat) (v : Scalar) : ZigState :=
  ZigState.mk
    (fun r a =>
      match Nat.decEq r region with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
          match Nat.decEq a addr with
          | Decidable.isTrue _ => v
          | Decidable.isFalse _ => σ.mem r a
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => σ.mem r a)
    σ.stack_base

def zReadSlice (σ : ZigState) (s : Slice) (idx : Nat) : Scalar :=
  zRead σ s.region idx

def zWriteSlice (σ : ZigState) (s : Slice) (idx : Nat) (v : Scalar) : ZigState :=
  zWrite σ s.region idx v

def repr (σ : ZigState) : Heap :=
  Heap.mk σ.mem σ.stack_base

def stateOfHeap (h : Heap) : ZigState :=
  ZigState.mk h.mem h.stack_top

def splitTensor (t : Tensor) (half : Nat) : Prod Slice Slice :=
  Prod.mk
    (Slice.mk regionX1 t.data.ptr half)
    (Slice.mk regionX2 (Nat.add t.data.ptr half) half)

def splitBackwardSlice (g : BackwardSlice) (half : Nat) : Prod Slice Slice :=
  Prod.mk
    (Slice.mk regionX1 g.data.ptr half)
    (Slice.mk regionX2 (Nat.add g.data.ptr half) half)

def allocStack (h : Heap) (n : Nat) : Prod Slice Heap :=
  Prod.mk
    (Slice.mk regionStack h.stack_top n)
    (Heap.mk h.mem (Nat.add h.stack_top n))

def isDisjoint (s1 s2 : Slice) : Prop :=
  s1.region ≠ s2.region ∨
    ((Nat.add s1.ptr s1.len ≤ s2.ptr) ∨ (Nat.add s2.ptr s2.len ≤ s1.ptr))

def guardedCell (old new : Scalar) (idx n : Nat) : Scalar :=
  match Nat.decLt idx n with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => new
  | Decidable.isFalse _ => old

def mixBufLoop (h : Heap) (src buf : Slice) (n : Nat) : Heap :=
  Heap.mk
    (fun r a =>
      match Nat.decEq r buf.region with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => guardedCell (readHeap h r a) (readSlice h src a) a n
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => readHeap h r a)
    h.stack_top

def addScaledLoop (h : Heap) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar) (n : Nat) : Heap :=
  Heap.mk
    (fun r a =>
      match Nat.decEq r dst.region with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
          guardedCell
            (readHeap h r a)
            (fadd (readSlice h dst a) (fmul (readSlice h src a) scale))
            a
            n
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => readHeap h r a)
    h.stack_top

def addScaledHalfLoop (h : Heap) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar) (n : Nat) : Heap :=
  Heap.mk
    (fun r a =>
      match Nat.decEq r dst.region with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
          guardedCell
            (readHeap h r a)
            (fadd (readSlice h dst a) (fmul (fmul (readSlice h src a) scale) halfCoeff))
            a
            n
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => readHeap h r a)
    h.stack_top

def forwardRunHeap (h : Heap) (t : Tensor) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar) : Heap :=
  let x1 := Prod.fst (splitTensor t dim)
  let x2 := Prod.snd (splitTensor t dim)
  let stackAlloc := allocStack h dim
  let mix_buf := Prod.fst stackAlloc
  let h0 := Prod.snd stackAlloc
  let h1 := mixBufLoop h0 x1 mix_buf dim
  let h2 := addScaledLoop h1 x1 x2 scale dim
  let h3 := addScaledHalfLoop h2 x2 mix_buf scale dim
  restoreStack h3 h.stack_top

def backwardRunHeap (h : Heap) (g : BackwardSlice) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar) : Heap :=
  let g1 := Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g dim)
  let g2 := Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g dim)
  let stackAlloc := allocStack h dim
  let buf := Prod.fst stackAlloc
  let h0 := Prod.snd stackAlloc
  let h1 := mixBufLoop h0 g2 buf dim
  let h2 := addScaledLoop h1 g2 g1 scale dim
  let h3 := addScaledHalfLoop h2 g1 buf scale dim
  restoreStack h3 h.stack_top

def forwardHeap (h : Heap) (t : Tensor) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar) : Heap :=
  match Nat.decLt t.data.len (Nat.mul dim natTwo) with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => h
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decLt maxBufSize dim with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => h
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => forwardRunHeap h t dim scale

def backwardHeap (h : Heap) (g : BackwardSlice) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar) : Heap :=
  match Nat.decLt g.data.len (Nat.mul dim natTwo) with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => h
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      match Nat.decLt maxBufSize dim with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => h
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => backwardRunHeap h g dim scale

def ZigForwardInPlace (σ : ZigState) (x : Tensor) (self : OFTB) : ZigState :=
  stateOfHeap (forwardHeap (repr σ) x self.dim self.fractal_scale)

def ZigBackwardInPlace (σ : ZigState) (grad : BackwardSlice) (self : OFTB) : ZigState :=
  stateOfHeap (backwardHeap (repr σ) grad self.dim self.fractal_scale)

inductive ExecMixBuf : ZigState → Slice → Slice → Nat → ZigState → Prop where
  | zero : ∀ (σ : ZigState) (src buf : Slice), ExecMixBuf σ src buf 0 σ
  | succ : ∀ (σ σ' : ZigState) (src buf : Slice) (k : Nat),
      ExecMixBuf σ src buf k σ' →
      ExecMixBuf σ src buf (Nat.succ k)
        (zWriteSlice σ' buf k (zReadSlice σ' src k))

inductive ExecAddScaled : ZigState → Slice → Slice → Scalar → Nat → ZigState → Prop where
  | zero : ∀ (σ : ZigState) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar),
      ExecAddScaled σ dst src scale 0 σ
  | succ : ∀ (σ σ' : ZigState) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar) (k : Nat),
      ExecAddScaled σ dst src scale k σ' →
      ExecAddScaled σ dst src scale (Nat.succ k)
        (zWriteSlice σ' dst k
          (fadd (zReadSlice σ' dst k) (fmul (zReadSlice σ' src k) scale)))

inductive ExecAddScaledHalf : ZigState → Slice → Slice → Scalar → Nat → ZigState → Prop where
  | zero : ∀ (σ : ZigState) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar),
      ExecAddScaledHalf σ dst src scale 0 σ
  | succ : ∀ (σ σ' : ZigState) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar) (k : Nat),
      ExecAddScaledHalf σ dst src scale k σ' →
      ExecAddScaledHalf σ dst src scale (Nat.succ k)
        (zWriteSlice σ' dst k
          (fadd (zReadSlice σ' dst k) (fmul (fmul (zReadSlice σ' src k) scale) halfCoeff)))

inductive ExecForward : ZigState → Tensor → OFTB → ZigState → Prop where
  | early_len : ∀ (σ : ZigState) (t : Tensor) (self : OFTB),
      t.data.len < self.dim  natTwo →
      ExecForward σ t self σ
  | early_buf : ∀ (σ : ZigState) (t : Tensor) (self : OFTB),
      ¬ (t.data.len < self.dim  natTwo) →
      maxBufSize < self.dim →
      ExecForward σ t self σ
  | run : ∀ (σ σ1 σ2 σ3 : ZigState) (t : Tensor) (self : OFTB) (mix_buf : Slice),
      ¬ (t.data.len < self.dim  natTwo) →
      ¬ (maxBufSize < self.dim) →
      (Prod.fst (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim)) = mix_buf →
      ExecMixBuf (stateOfHeap (Prod.snd (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim))) (Prod.fst (splitTensor t self.dim)) mix_buf self.dim σ1 →
      ExecAddScaled σ1 (Prod.fst (splitTensor t self.dim)) (Prod.snd (splitTensor t self.dim)) self.fractal_scale self.dim σ2 →
      ExecAddScaledHalf σ2 (Prod.snd (splitTensor t self.dim)) mix_buf self.fractal_scale self.dim σ3 →
      ExecForward σ t self (stateOfHeap (restoreStack (repr σ3) σ.stack_base))

inductive ExecBackward : ZigState → BackwardSlice → OFTB → ZigState → Prop where
  | early_len : ∀ (σ : ZigState) (g : BackwardSlice) (self : OFTB),
      g.data.len < self.dim  natTwo →
      ExecBackward σ g self σ
  | early_buf : ∀ (σ : ZigState) (g : BackwardSlice) (self : OFTB),
      ¬ (g.data.len < self.dim  natTwo) →
      maxBufSize < self.dim →
      ExecBackward σ g self σ
  | run : ∀ (σ σ1 σ2 σ3 : ZigState) (g : BackwardSlice) (self : OFTB) (buf : Slice),
      ¬ (g.data.len < self.dim  natTwo) →
      ¬ (maxBufSize < self.dim) →
      (Prod.fst (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim)) = buf →
      ExecMixBuf (stateOfHeap (Prod.snd (allocStack (repr σ) self.dim))) (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) buf self.dim σ1 →
      ExecAddScaled σ1 (Prod.snd (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) self.fractal_scale self.dim σ2 →
      ExecAddScaledHalf σ2 (Prod.fst (splitBackwardSlice g self.dim)) buf self.fractal_scale self.dim σ3 →
      ExecBackward σ g self (stateOfHeap (restoreStack (repr σ3) σ.stack_base))

theorem addScaledLoop_at_dst (h : Heap) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar) (n m : Nat)
  (hm : m < n) :
  semanticEq
    (readSlice (addScaledLoop h dst src scale n) dst m)
    (fadd (readSlice h dst m) (fmul (readSlice h src m) scale)) :=
  match Nat.decEq dst.region dst.region with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
      match Nat.decLt m n with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => Eq.refl _
      | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf hm)
  | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf (Eq.refl _))

theorem addScaledHalfLoop_at_dst (h : Heap) (dst src : Slice) (scale : Scalar) (n m : Nat)
  (hm : m < n) :
  semanticEq
    (readSlice (addScaledHalfLoop h dst src scale n) dst m)
    (fadd (readSlice h dst m) (fmul (fmul (readSlice h src m) scale) halfCoeff)) :=
  match Nat.decEq dst.region dst.region with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
      match Nat.decLt m n with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => Eq.refl _
      | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf hm)
  | Decidable.isFalse hf => False.elim (hf (Eq.refl _))

  (hnlen : ¬ (t.data.len < dim  natTwo))
  (hnbuf : ¬ (maxBufSize < dim))
  (m : Nat) (hm : m < dim) :

    (zigF32Add (readSlice h (Prod.fst (splitTensor t dim)) m)
      (zigF32Mul (readSlice h (Prod.snd (splitTensor t dim)) m) scale)) :=

  | Decidable.isTrue hlt => False.elim (hnlen hlt)
  | Decidable.isFalse _ =>

  (hnlen : ¬ (t.data.len < dim  natTwo))
  (hnbuf : ¬ (maxBufSize < dim))
  (m : Nat) (hm : m < dim) :

theorem backward_g1_spec (h : Heap) (g : BackwardSlice) (dim : Nat) (scale : Scalar)
  (hnlen : ¬ (g.data.len < dim  natTwo))
  (hnbuf : ¬ (maxBufSize < dim))
